decision:log.title: Every action has an owner
decision:log.body:
### 2026-10-08: Every action has an owner

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** team-delivery

**Triggers:** decision:log

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** Every action in the tracker names one owner and a date.

**Why:** Unowned work does not finish.

**How to apply:** Refuse to leave an action without an owner. If the owner is unknown, record that as an open question.

escalation:open.title: Name who is affected today
escalation:open.body:
### 2026-10-08: Name who is affected today

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** team-escalation

**Triggers:** escalation:open

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** An escalation assessment names who is affected, the decision needed today, and what is watched next.

**Why:** Urgent team issues drift when the decision is vague.

**How to apply:** Fill those three points before asking for response approval.

escalation:open.title: Response waits for approval
escalation:open.body:
### 2026-10-08: Response waits for approval

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** team-escalation

**Triggers:** escalation:open

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** Do not carry out the response until the operator says I approve the response or Skip response approval.

**Why:** An urgent people or delivery move still needs an explicit yes.

**How to apply:** Set the next action to wait for response approval and stop.

escalation:open.title: Record what is watched
escalation:open.body:
### 2026-10-08: Record what is watched

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** team-escalation

**Triggers:** escalation:open

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** Monitoring names the signal and the next check time.

**Why:** A response without a watch item looks finished when it is not.

**How to apply:** Write the signal and the time into the escalation file.

hiring:loop.title: Headcount and offers wait for approval
hiring:loop.body:
### 2026-10-08: Headcount and offers wait for approval

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** team-delivery

**Triggers:** hiring:loop

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** Headcount and offers are recommendations until the operator explicitly approves them.

**Why:** Hiring authority is often narrower than day-to-day delivery authority.

**How to apply:** Prepare the hiring-loop note. Stop before any offer or headcount commitment. Wait for an explicit yes.

hiring:loop.title: Separate the lasting staffing change
hiring:loop.body:
### 2026-10-08: Separate the lasting staffing change

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** team-escalation

**Triggers:** hiring:loop

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** A lasting staffing change discovered during an escalation is a change request, not part of the immediate response.

**Why:** Urgent response and standing staffing are different decisions.

**How to apply:** Write the immediate step in the escalation file. Open a change request for the lasting change.

meeting:1on1.title: 1:1 notes stay on the work item
meeting:1on1.body:
### 2026-10-08: 1:1 notes stay on the work item

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** team-delivery

**Triggers:** meeting:1on1

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** 1:1 notes, performance comments, and personal circumstances stay on the work item unless the operator explicitly says to store them in expert-role memory.

**Why:** People-sensitive notes must not become standing expert memory by default.

**How to apply:** Write the note under the work item. Ask before any expert-role copy. If the operator does not say yes, do not copy it.

status:update.title: Status leads with risk
status:update.body:
### 2026-10-08: Status leads with risk

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** team-delivery

**Triggers:** status:update

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** A status update leads with the current risk, then the outcome, then the ask.

**Why:** Stakeholders act on risk first.

**How to apply:** Open with the risk. Name the owner and the next check.

status:update.title: Tell stakeholders in the same step
status:update.body:
### 2026-10-08: Tell stakeholders in the same step

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** team-escalation

**Triggers:** status:update

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** The response includes what is communicated and to whom.

**Why:** Silence is a decision.

**How to apply:** Name the audience and the message in the response before monitoring starts.
